_note: Fixed terms, PLAN.md §8.7. Use these words, not synonyms.

terms.bleeding: Any blood loss logged, including spotting and bleeding outside a period.
terms.spotting: Very light bleeding, less than a period.
terms.cycle: From the first day of one period to the day before the next.
terms.estimate: A calculated guess shown with a range, never a certainty.
terms.range: The span of days an estimate is likely to fall in.
terms.ovulation: When an egg is released. Sanguine estimates this day and shows a range.
terms.fertile window: The days around ovulation shown with a likelihood. Darker means more likely to be in the window.
terms.biomarker: A measurable sign such as temperature, an ovulation test or cervical mucus.

preferred.typical range: Use instead of a verdict word.
